summary: Tested Referral & E-commerce mobile app. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth, payment, 1+4 referral payout, withdrawals, admin endpoints. Frontend: critical flows verified - root redirects to /login, admin login lands on /admin/users with stats and user list, register with sponsor code → /payment → /(tabs)/dashboard works end-to-end with referral code displayed and bottom tabs visible.

issues: Console deprecation warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (RN warning, not user-facing)
Image style.resizeMode deprecation warning - migrate to props.resizeMode

react_native_issues.issue: Bottom tab buttons (Home/Network/Wallet/Shop/Profile and Users/Payouts/Txns/Account) lack testID attributes (e.g. admin-tab-payouts, tab-network). Tabs render and are tappable, but cannot be reliably targeted by automation. Recommend adding tabBarButton testID via tabBarButtonTestID/tabBarTestID props or screenOptions.
Optional: add a top-level testID='dashboard-screen' wrapper for easier test targeting (currently navigation-by-URL works fine).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add testID props on bottom tab bar buttons in (tabs)/_layout.tsx and admin/_layout.tsx for robust E2E selectors (e.g. options={{ tabBarButtonTestID: 'tab-network' }}).
(Optional/cosmetic) Replace deprecated style.resizeMode and props.pointerEvents usages to silence RN warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 569 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into auth.py / users.py / withdrawals.py / admin.py / payment.py routers as feature set grows.
/api/auth/logout is a no-op for stateless JWT - acceptable but document for clients (no token blacklist).
Withdrawals lock balance on request and refund on reject - good. However on approve there's no double-spend check beyond status; protected by unique status transition (re-approve returns 400). OK.
_count_team uses BFS without depth limit - fine for current scale but consider $graphLookup for very large trees.
Pydantic v2: BankUpdate.dict() / ProductCreate.dict() are deprecated (model_dump preferred) - works but emits warnings on newer pydantic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows tested (login redirect, admin login→admin/users, register→payment→dashboard, referral code propagation)

seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates ephemeral TEST_<uuid>@test.com users via /api/auth/register; payments/withdrawals scoped to those test users. Several test users persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py is the regression suite. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public base. Admin: admin@app.com / Admin@123 (referral_code ADMIN001). Use ADMIN001 as the sponsor code when creating UI test users. Bottom-tab/admin-tab testIDs are NOT present yet; navigate via URL (/admin/payouts, /(tabs)/wallet, etc.) until added.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All tested behaviors match spec: 1+4 payout credits ₹400 to sponsor only on the 4th paid direct, second register-fee returns 400, reject refunds locked balance, non-admin tokens get 403 on admin endpoints, products/users responses exclude MongoDB _id and password_hash.
